about: Logos, categories and triggers for the apps in data/actions, written by scripts/refresh-app-data.py. Apps, logos, categories and trigger names come from lodol.com; each trigger's filters and event fields from Lodol's MCP server.

Runs when a new transaction appears in Mercury. Optionally limit it to a single account.

output.accountId: The Mercury account the transaction belongs to.
output.amount: Amount in dollars - negative for debits, positive for credits.
output.status: pending, sent, cancelled, failed, reversed or blocked.
output.kind: What kind of transaction it is, for example externalTransfer.
output.counterpartyName: Who the money went to or came from.
output.note: Internal note, if one is set.
output.dashboardLink: Link to the transaction in Mercury.

triggers.description: Triggers when a new email arrives in a folder of an Outlook mailbox - the inbox unless you choose another - optionally only from one sender or domain. Runs once for each email, with its text.

params.name: mailbox
params.description: The mailbox to watch: a user's email address in the Microsoft 365 tenant the app was consented in.

params.name: sender
params.description: Only emails from this address, or from a whole domain written as @example.com. Leave blank for every new email.

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder to watch: a folder ID or a well-known name such as inbox, junkemail or archive. Leave blank for the inbox.

triggers.description: Triggers when a new page is added to a Notion database
Triggers when a new payment is received in PayPal

params.name: status
params.description: Only run for payments with this PayPal status code: S for completed payments, P pending, V reversed, D denied. Leave empty to run for every payment.
